claim: Screens that time themselves with CPU delay loops (title, attract, name entry) run far too fast at 28 MHz; speed up only during play and check every non-play screen for software timing.

evidence.text: 28MHz only from the level draw to the next Layer 2 off; title, scores, name entry and continue run at 3.5MHz (busy-loop timing). At 28MHz every update took 3 frames (45% fast; recording averages 4.35, title alternates 2 and 3); title to scores 621 vs original 597 frames.
